gold_doubt: The article says IREN signed an AI cloud services contract with NVIDIA, but it does not explicitly say NVIDIA is the buyer. The gold's buyer attribution and its proposed purchase-obligation question go beyond the article as written.

The gold excludes an IREN FY2028 question as a year after next or later. The article dates IREN's fiscal year end to June; on the July 2026 publication date, FY2028 would normally be the next fiscal year. The article also says FY2025 ended last June, which is inconsistent with its publication date.

B's question asks about the individual contract, whereas the gold's may-open question asks about a broader plan. It fails the section 4 verifiability test because the article does not establish that NVIDIA's annual report will separately disclose the IREN contract amount; the specified note could report an aggregate.
